recorded.letter:
**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION APPROVAL**

**Service:** Continuous Glucose Monitor  
**Order Date:** June 12, 2025  
**Decision:** APPROVED

---

**Criteria Met:**

**Diagnosis Requirement:** Met  
Patient has Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia (E11.65), active since August 17, 2020.

**Clinical Need Requirement:** Met  
Patient demonstrates problematic hypoglycemia with recurrent Level 2 events (glucose <54 mg/dL) despite medication adjustments. Documentation shows three capillary glucose readings below 54 mg/dL: 47 mg/dL (April 19, 2025), 44 mg/dL (April 29, 2025), and 45 mg/dL (June 5, 2025). Endocrinology records confirm persistent lows despite two separate medication interventions: glipizide dose reduction in March and replacement with sitagliptin in May 2025.

**Recent Visit Requirement:** Met  
In-person diabetes follow-up visit with Dr. P. Adeyemi on May 14, 2025 (29 days prior to order), within the required 6-month window. Visit included glucose log review, HbA1c assessment, evaluation of diabetes control and hypoglycemia risk, and discussion of continuous glucose monitoring.

---

This authorization is valid for one year from the order date. Please submit claims with this authorization number.
